label: Goblin A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The exact original adult male green-skinned goblin warrior: lean muscular upright body, long bare green arms, small stern angular face, pointed green ears, narrow yellow eyes and jutting lower teeth. Olive-green skin with yellow-green highlights and deep forest shadows. Tall narrow ornate brass helmet with a swept-back brown-gold segmented crest, brass brow rim and small side spikes; thin reddish brown hair extends below the helmet at the back. Sleeveless close-fitting muted blue-teal vest with deep V neckline and fine gold edge trim, dark diagonal shoulder strap. One heavy spiked brass pauldron on his left shoulder and ornate brass segmented armor down his left arm; right forearm has a dark blue cloth bracer with gold trim. Bare green hands hold the native single long slightly curved broad silver blade diagonally across his waist, right hand at the small gold hilt. Blade has a rusty red-brown center line and bright silver edge; preserve exact length, curvature, grip and angle in every pose. Dark navy-blue fitted trousers with brown leather bands at knees and native gold studded side details. Brown knee-high leather boots with pointed brass spiked shin guards visible from the front. Brass waist belt, thin gold hanging side straps and dark rear harness exactly as native. Keep skin, hair, brass, steel and brown boots unchanged; only blue-teal vest and dark navy trousers/bracer recolor separately to their native variants. No shield, cape, extra weapon, glow or redesign. Preserve the native slender proportions, dark tonal weight and asymmetric armor.
